name: Salesmate
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Salesmate, track contacts and deals and send low-volume permissioned email through a user provider. The hard boundary is built-in calling, texting, sequences, automations, and sales integrations, plus integrations, data quality, and workflow lock-in.
